desc: Read N, intervals, Q, and queries from stdin.
Determine the array size n = max(500000, max_R, max_X) + N + 1.
Implement the `SegTree` class with `range_add`, `find_first_ge`, and `point_query` methods.
Build the segment tree with initial values `F[x] = x` for x in [1, n].
Process each contest interval: for each (L, R), compute a = find_first_ge(L), b = (find_first_ge(R+1) - 1) if find_first_ge(R+1) exists else n; if a <= b, call range_add(a, b, 1).
Test the implementation on the provided sample inputs to ensure correctness.
If any sample fails, debug and fix issues (e.g., edge cases, off-by-one errors, or performance).
